# SolekTech

> SolekTech engineers advanced biodigester sewage and wastewater treatment systems for homes, estates, hotels, institutions, and industry in Lagos, Nigeria.

SolekTech designs, installs, and maintains sealed underground biodigester systems that use natural anaerobic digestion to treat sewage — no odor, no chemicals, minimal maintenance, and full environmental compliance.
